action.objective: Activate the rook to e1 as the primary verified safe candidate and improve piece activity.
action.rationale: f1e1 is the only commit-ready move: it was verified at completed depth 3 with an exact score of 1 (best of all candidates), complete immediate-mate safety, and no tactical or checking-chain refutations found. The earlier broad search's exact row (f1e1, -25 at depth 2) and this deeper verification (score 1, depth 3) agree it is at least as good as alternatives like f5f6 or f1g1, which were only upper bounds and cannot be trusted. The rook gains the open e-file with no immediate material loss; h2c2 Rxc2 is a possible Black capture but not a forced win for Black within the bounded search.
